displayName: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution Tommi Mäkinen Edition (VI)
aliases: Lancer Evolution VI Tommi Mäkinen Edition

production.note: Calendar years, Japan. Quote (Motor-Fan, 竹村 純): "1999（平成11）年12月10日、三菱自動車は...「トミー・マキネン・エディション（TME）」を翌2000年1月8日に発売することを発表した。" (on sale 8 January 2000). The Gulliver catalog (database) lists the GSR TME sold "平成12年1月〜平成12年9月" (January–September 2000); Evo's panel: "On sale 2000". Never sold new in the US, so the home market is used.

aspiration.note: Single turbocharger (titanium-aluminide turbine on the TME per Motor-Fan).

powerHp.note: Quote (Evo specification panel): "Max power 276bhp @ 6500rpm", which is the Japanese 280 PS rating x 0.98632 = 276 hp. The 280 PS figure is given by the Gulliver catalog (gulliver-evo-vi-tme-gsr, database): "280ps (206kW) / 6500rpm". No Mitsubishi document was found.

weightLb.note: Evo specification panel (step 2), GSR: 1,365 kg x 2.20462 = 3,009 lb. Quote: "Weight 1365kg" (unlabelled; read as kerb since Evo marks dry figures as dry). Evo describes the car as Japanese-market (UK cars were personal imports). The Gulliver catalog (database) lists the Japanese GSR TME at "車両重量 1360kg" (2,998 lb). The lighter RS grade is not described.

discrepancies.reason: Evo prints 1,365 kg; the Japanese catalog listing gives 1,360 kg for the GSR TME (0.4% apart). Possibly rounding or a car built for UK import.
discrepancies.resolution: Used Evo's panel figure, which qualifies at step 2; a database is not acceptable for weight.

reviewNotes: End year 2000 rests on Evo ("On sale 2000") and a catalog sales period ending September 2000; some sources say the TME stayed on sale until the Evolution VII (2001). Evo says UK TMEs were personal imports of Japanese cars, so its 1,365 kg is a Japanese-market figure; the catalog gives 1,360 kg (0.4% apart).
